channel.title: The Daily AI Drop
channel.description: Twice daily, Alex and Jordan watch the best AI channels on YouTube so you don't have to. New videos summarized, explained, and put in context — every morning and evening.

item.title: The Daily AI Drop - Evening Edition, October 8, 2026
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down twenty afternoon AI videos: OpenAI's Intelligent UI rollout and Oracle's hiring copilot, Codex production monitoring, Google's ten million dollar bid for old work emails, Gemma 4 and EmbeddingGemma 2 on-device demos, plus forward deployed engineering jobs, portfolio projects that get you hired, and why agent costs explode.

item.title: The Daily AI Drop - Morning Edition, October 8, 2026
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down six overnight AI videos: LangChain on agent skills and OpenAI's hidden prompt-cache ceiling, Claude Haiku 5.5 going ten times cheaper and taking on GPT 6 Luna, Nate B. Jones asking whether Google can catch up, and Fahd Mirza testing a tiny local multimodal decision model.

item.title: The Daily AI Drop - Evening Edition, October 7, 2026
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down OpenAI DevDay 2026: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI, ChatGPT plugins, the Codex arc, and cost-cutting playbooks — plus Claude Haiku 5.5 tested, Gemini Argon on the leaderboard, Gemini 3.8 Live golf coaching, and LangChain Academy.

item.title: The Daily AI Drop - Morning Edition, October 7, 2026
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down three overnight AI videos: Google's open on-device EmbeddingGemma 2 multimodal embedding model, and two videos on getting GTA 5 running in a browser.

item.title: The Daily AI Drop - Evening Edition, October 6, 2026
item.description: Alex and Jordan cover 6 fresh videos: Mistral Large 4 tested, 10 open-source replacements for paid AI subscriptions, Addy Osmani's Agent Skills, LangChain's Deep Agents harness, model routing, and one-config web search for agents.

item.title: The Daily AI Drop - Morning Edition, October 6, 2026
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down 11 fresh AI videos from 8 YouTube channels: Reflection Beam vs Cohere North 2, DeepSeek's hackable Harness, Meta's Muse agent negotiating with Siraj Raval's agent, LangChain Skills, 13 agentic-era businesses, and more.
